findings.finding: The retire-intent recovery validator required every retained outer value to equal its nested terminal value. Real migration state legitimately replaces the pre-migration migration_ledger_sha256 with the applied post-migration digest, so every realistic retirement recovery failed with PRODUCTION_RUNNER_RETIRE_STATE_INVALID before retirement.
findings.required_remediation: Define the exact allowed state transition by preserving every retained field except the explicitly permitted migration ledger digest and terminal phase/timestamp fields, and cover it with a realistic pre-hash to post-hash recovery regression.
